ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting physical topography irregularities on the lobe tips and trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellow-hued chromatic variance in the pigmentation of the right lobe's white field.
